assertions.assertion: Sets options.MutualTls.DomainName = "mtls" for the sub-domain endpoint strategy

Configures certificate forwarding via AddCertificateForwarding with the proxy's certificate header (e.g. X-SSL-CERT) and a HeaderConverter, and calls UseCertificateForwarding() before UseAuthentication()
assertions.rationale: AddCertificateForwarding with X-SSL-CERT header, HeaderConverter, UseCertificateForwarding() before UseAuthentication().

assertions.assertion: Sets Kestrel ClientCertificateMode.NoCertificate because the reverse proxy terminates TLS
Uses AllowedCertificateTypes = CertificateTypes.Chained for production PKI certificates
Explains clients read the mTLS token endpoint from disco.MtlsEndpointAliases (mtls_endpoint_aliases in discovery) and that the proxy must strip or overwrite the inbound certificate header
assertions.rationale: Uses disco.MtlsEndpointAliases / mtls_endpoint_aliases and says proxy must strip/overwrite header.
